---
title: "uv-python execution options parity"
engine: uv-python
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
  eval: true
  include: true
  output: true
  warning: false
  error: false
---

This fixture exercises the supported static execution option subset.

Document-level `warning: false` suppresses Python warnings but not ordinary
stderr.

```{python}
import sys
import warnings

warnings.warn("document warning should be suppressed")
sys.stderr.write("stderr survives warning false\n")
print("document defaults execute")
```

Chunk-local `warning: true` overrides the document default.

```{python}
#| warning: true
import warnings

warnings.warn("chunk warning visible")
```

`output: asis` inserts stdout as raw Markdown.

```{python}
#| output: asis
print("## Raw Markdown From Stdout\n")
print("| name | value |")
print("| --- | ---: |")
print("| alpha | 1 |")
```

Normal `output: true` remains fenced text, not raw Markdown.

```{python}
print("# Not Raw Heading")
```

`echo: fenced` displays a non-executable tutorial fence while the code still
executes once.

```{python}
#| echo: fenced
#| output: false
tutorial_count = globals().get("tutorial_count", 0) + 1
print("hidden echo-fenced stdout")
```

```{python}
print(f"echo fenced executed {tutorial_count} time")
```

`include: false` hides output while preserving execution side effects.

```{python}
#| include: false
hidden_option_value = "include false executed"
print("hidden include false output")
```

```{python}
print(hidden_option_value)
```

`eval: false` skips execution but can still echo the source.

```{python}
#| eval: false
#| echo: true
eval_false_value = "should not exist"
print("eval false should not execute")
```

```{python}
print("eval false skipped", "eval_false_value" in globals())
```

`error: true` renders the traceback and allows following chunks to continue.

```{python}
#| error: true
raise RuntimeError("allowed parity error")
```

```{python}
print("continued after parity options error")
```
